model_rationale: InceptionResnetV1 pretrained on VGGFace2 via facenet-pytorch. Chosen for strong open-source support, L2-normalized 512-dim embeddings, and proven LFW benchmark performance (~99.6% accuracy). Preferred over: ArcFace/InsightFace (heavier inference stack, harder to install), Dlib (lower accuracy on unconstrained images), MobileFaceNet (speed-accuracy tradeoff not needed for offline evaluation).
